title: Data Analyst, Regulatory Analytics and Reporting
description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

We're looking for a Data Analyst, Regulatory Analytics and Reporting to join our team remotely! The #1 goal of this role is to turn complex compliance and regulatory data into clear, actionable insights that protect the business, satisfy regulators, and support senior leadership in making high-stakes decisions. You'll work at the intersection of data engineering, regulatory reporting, and compliance operations in a fast-paced, high-scrutiny environment where accuracy and audit-readiness are non-negotiable.

Beyond technical expertise, success in this role depends on being a true business partner who combines data-driven insights with deep knowledge of compliance regulations and frameworks. You'll own end-to-end data management from building and maintaining datasets and pipelines to designing dashboards and insights for compliance and leadership teams. You will also automate compliance processes and workflows to boost efficiency and minimize human error.

If you combine exceptional data analysis expertise with solid knowledge of compliance regulations, a keen eye for regulatory risk, and the drive to shape the future of crypto with a top-tier brand - this is your next mission!

 

The opportunity

  • Own the design of dashboards, compliance metrics, and regulatory reports, turning data into actionable insights for stakeholders, cross-functional partners, and regional compliance officers

  • Automate end to end compliance related data solutions, governance controls, and automations to boost efficiency and minimize manual intervention

  • Dive into large, complex datasets to turn findings into scalable, audit-ready data models that facilitate regulatory reporting and analytics

  • Translate regulatory and business requests into accurate reports and automated data pipelines using Python, SQL, DBT and Airflow

  • Lead cross-functional projects with analysts, engineers, and compliance teams to build and maintain high-quality data pipelines and sources

  • Coordinate client data quality monitoring by identifying issues, flagging remediations, and partnering with responsible teams to ensure timely resolution

  • Support ad-hoc data requests for audits, exams, risk assessments, and day-to-day business needs

  • Deliver insights that shape compliance direction through clear, data-driven storytelling

 

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in data analysis and data management within financial services or a regulated industry, with hands-on experience in compliance and regulatory reporting across frameworks such as AML, KYC, Sanctions, MiCA, or MiFID

  • Solid understanding of regulatory risk and the ability to operate effectively in high-scrutiny, audit-ready environments

  • Expert SQL skills including complex joins, CTEs, and analytical functions, paired with proficiency in Python libraries such as pandas, matplotlib, and plotly

  • Hands-on experience using dbt or similar tooling to model and organize high fidelity data for reporting and decision-making

  • Experience setting up and managing data pipelines with a strong understanding of data workflow orchestration

  • Proficiency with BI and data visualization tools such as QuickSight, Power BI, or Superset to build executive-facing dashboards

  • Strong communicator who can simplify complex data ideas for both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Alignment with the values outlined in Kraken's Tentaclements document

 

Nice to haves

  • Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Information Systems, or a related technical field

  • Passion for continuous learning and approaching problems with a beginner's mindset

  • Solid understanding of the cryptocurrency space and how financial markets function

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Stay connected

title: Senior Data Analyst - Traffic / Acquisition (f/m/d)
Senior Data Analyst - Traffic / Acquisition
Senior Data Analyst, People Analytics
description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will play a leading role in the People Analytics team at Checkout.com. Our mission is to enable data-driven people decisions across the organisation, from the executive team to individual managers.

You will own analytics solutions end-to-end, backed by solid analytics engineering skills: the stakeholder instincts to deliver products that people actually use, the analytical judgement to turn data into insight, and the curiosity to push the boundary of what People Analytics can do with AI.

This is an embedded role. You will sit inside the People team and work directly with People leaders, the executive team, and partner departments such as Finance and Business Partnering. You will own the whole solution, from data modelling and pipeline work through to visualisation, analysis, insight and ongoing stakeholder support, rather than handing work to another team to finish.

This is a senior individual contributor role with real scope. You will own a portfolio of stakeholder relationships, shape what we build next, and contribute to one of the most ambitious People Analytics strategies in the business.

Job responsibilities

End-to-end product development. Own the full product development lifecycle for assigned stakeholder groups, from requirements gathering and design to pipeline development, Looker delivery, and enablement. You will be the primary People Analytics partner for Business Partnering and Finance, responsible for both supporting existing products and delivering new ones.

Advanced analytics. Conduct analyses that go beyond what happened to explain why and anticipate what comes next. Partner with the People Analytics Manager and senior stakeholders on the most complex and strategically important questions.

AI. Design, build, and deploy AI-powered data products. Working from our People Analytics AI roadmap, you will identify high-value use cases and deliver production-grade solutions, from intelligent data applications to agentic workflows, using our cloud-native stack.

Enablement. Drive data fluency across your stakeholder groups through demos, documentation, training, and self-service tooling. Make data accessible, not just available.

Data quality. Keep the data behind your products reliable and well documented, contributing to the continuous improvement of our pipeline, semantic layer, and the data products we share with other teams.

Growth opportunities

We want this role to grow. As you establish yourself:

  • Broader product ownership: expand into additional stakeholder groups and more complex, cross-functional products

  • AI at scale: build increasingly sophisticated AI products, from intelligent data applications to agentic tools used across the business

  • Strategic influence: move further into consultative and diagnostic work, shaping how senior leaders interpret and act on people data

Key requirements

Essential

  • Experience owning data products end-to-end for business stakeholders, from requirements gathering through design, delivery and adoption

  • Track record of turning an ambiguous business question into a scoped deliverable, working directly with the stakeholder to get there

  • Significant experience as a data analyst, ideally in a team with established data engineering practices

  • Strong SQL, with hands-on experience in BigQuery or a comparable cloud data warehouse

  • Experience building and maintaining production data transformation code, meaning layered, version-controlled and tested models rather than one-off queries, with dbt or a comparable tool

  • Experience building dashboards and reporting in a data visualisation platform such as Looker, Tableau or Power BI

  • Excellent communication skills, able to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for non-technical audiences

  • Collaborative, enablement-focused mindset: you build for self-service, not dependency

Desirable

  • Experience applying statistical or predictive techniques to a business problem

  • Exposure to AI product development, LLM tooling, or data applications

  • Experience with data quality frameworks, semantic layers, or data observability tooling

  • Prior experience working with HR, people, or workforce data

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

title: Data Analyst Assistant
description:
About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

title: Junior Digital Assets Operations Analyst
description:
Application URL
https://omegadg.com/work/remoteok

Omega Enterprises is an international digital-assets company focused on cryptocurrency markets, market intelligence, and data-based financial operations. We are expanding our team and looking for motivated people who would like to build practical knowledge of digital markets and develop their analytical skills.

This is an entry-level opportunity designed for candidates who are interested in cryptocurrency, financial markets, and working with market information. Previous employment in the crypto industry is not necessary. New team members receive onboarding, training, and ongoing support from experienced colleagues.

What You'll Do

  • Follow daily developments across cryptocurrency and digital-asset markets.
  • Assist the team with routine operational and analytical activities.
  • Track changes in prices, trading activity, liquidity, and other relevant indicators.
  • Gather information from internal and external market-data sources.
  • Maintain organized records and prepare concise internal reports.
  • Summarize market observations for team discussions.
  • Take part in regular training, feedback sessions, and team meetings.
  • Complete structured tasks under the guidance of more experienced team members.

What You'll Get

  • Fully remote working arrangement.
  • Flexible day-to-day workflow.
  • Structured onboarding for people new to the crypto industry.
  • Training in basic market-analysis and digital-asset tools.
  • Access to practical market information and analytical resources.
  • Regular feedback and guidance from a mentor.
  • A clear path for developing toward more advanced analytical responsibilities.
  • Opportunity to work within an international digital-assets team.

The Person We're Looking For

  • Are genuinely interested in cryptocurrency, financial markets, or market analytics.
  • Enjoy learning new tools and working with structured information.
  • Pay attention to detail when handling data and written tasks.
  • Can follow procedures and instructions consistently.
  • Are dependable, organized, and comfortable working independently.
  • Have English proficiency around B2 or higher, sufficient for professional tools, market information, and training materials.

Position Details

  • Position: Junior Digital Assets Operations Analyst
  • Work format: Remote
  • Experience: Entry level / training provided
